name: Shindou Kotone
source:
A female student suddenly transferred to the school.
She is a solitary girl who seems to refuse to interact with her surroundings.
She is a strong-willed, enigmatic person who maintains a pouty attitude from start to finish.
She is searching for Fairy Flower for some purpose, and seems to be investigating the main character behind the scenes. ......?

[Translated from [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item194528/af-6214]Gyutto[/url]]
